record.category: hosted workflow engine and script runner

free_tier.stated: Community plan on Windmill Cloud with no credit card: 1,000 free executions per user per month and 1,000 free executions per workspace per month; one execution is one job of up to 1 second on a worker with 2GB of memory, and each further second counts as another execution
free_tier.notes: An execution is also counted per second of job time, so the count is partly wall-clock. Job run details are kept 60 days. Windmill Cloud is hosted in the US.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: the plan and getting-started pages quoted name no limit on a job's payload or result size

retention.stated: job run details are retained for 60 days on the Community plan (cloud)

egress.terms: not stated: the plan pages name no charge or cap on traffic out of a job

record.interface_detail: Every request to the Windmill API carries a Bearer user token, which can be scoped; the wmill CLI syncs scripts and authenticates with a user token
record.tooling: the Windmill web app, the REST API with user tokens and the wmill CLI
record.chaining: A hosted scheduler and script runner on a 2GB worker: 1,000 one-second jobs a month cover an hourly check that calls free APIs and writes to a free database.

limits.value: 1,000 free executions per user per month and 1,000 per workspace per month

record.binding_note: A job longer than one second counts once per second, so 1,000 executions is at most 1,000 seconds, about 16 minutes, of job time a month.

identity_cost.detail: No credit card required; sign-up with GitHub, GitLab, Google or Microsoft SSO, and the login page also offers a login without a third party.

record.limits_note: The free self-hosted edition caps an instance at 3 workspaces, 50 users, 10 users with SSO, a 10 GiB workspace object storage quota, job run details kept up to 30 days and 100 trigger emails a day; executions are unlimited.

identity_cost.detail: No account with Windmill is needed: the documented install downloads docker-compose.yml, Caddyfile and.env from raw.githubusercontent.com and runs docker compose up, and the first login is on the user's own instance.

record.confidence_note: the pricing page was read on 2026-10-22. 'Unlimited executions' is a claim about a missing limit, so it is recorded as the unit unlimited and not multiplied into a capacity figure

record.notes: The hosted Community plan that Windmill runs is dev-services/windmill-cloud (also recorded as compute/windmill-cloud) and comes first. This record is no duplicate of it and stays: it is the open-source edition that the user installs and runs, with unlimited executions on the user's own instance, and it is the last resort.
record.binding_note: Executions are unlimited when self-hosted, so no vendor cap binds a single user's jobs; the machine the user runs the instance on bounds throughput.
